rule: PREREG_R6 5.5: m_F(f) = float64 mean of f's 10 phase-F consensus AUCs; m_P_fresh = float64 mean of the incumbent's phase-F consensus AUCs over its ok, non-flagged runs (>= 8 required, else +inf); f replaces P iff (a) f has 10 ok, non-flagged phase-F runs, (b) own-input SP-SR = MP-SR = 1 in >= 8 of them and (c) m_F(f) >= max(m_P_frozen, m_P_fresh) + 0.01 (exact floats); otherwise P stays. PREREG_R6 5.6: trial t is complete for a set iff every episode's job has an ok, non-flagged run t; R6-CLOSEST = the complete S6 trial whose 30-episode mean own-input AUC is closest to the mean over the complete S6 trials (ties: smaller distance of its consensus-B mean to the mean of that quantity, then lower t); R6-CLOSEST replaces R5-CLOSEST iff (i) >= 1 episode changed, (ii) Delta_B = mean over the trials complete for both sets of (S6 - S5 30-episode mean consensus-B AUC) >= +0.001 and (iii) S6's mean own-input SP-SR and MP-SR over those trials are each >= S5's.
upload_eligibility: R6-CLOSEST replaces R5-CLOSEST as the upload-eligible Tier-2 file (PREREG_R6 5.6)
r5_closest: R5-CLOSEST (round 5 SELECTION_R5.sha256 58e8b54b..., packed file sha256 e8a03a4d...)
